raw_dom.observation_method: Full DOM AST parse (tree walk, zero layout engine)
raw_dom.limitations: No dynamic JS execution, no computed CSS styling/visibility, lacks actionability mapping.

blink_axtree.observation_method: Native accessibility tree compiled by browser engine (roles, accessible names, states)
blink_axtree.test_method: Local execution via CDP session on multi_framework_observation_fixture.html
blink_axtree.limitations: Excludes non-standard attributes (data-*), strips script tags; non-interactive nodes may require explicit accessible roles to avoid generic pruning.

browser_use_default.observation_method: Interactive DOM serialization with DEFAULT_INCLUDE_ATTRIBUTES whitelist
browser_use_default.limitations: Prunes script/style/meta tags via DISABLED_ELEMENTS; filters out non-whitelisted attributes; strips tags of non-interactive elements.

browser_use_extended.observation_method: Interactive DOM serialization with EXTENDED_ATTRIBUTES whitelist (runner patch)
browser_use_extended.limitations: Retains data-* on interactive nodes only; still prunes script/meta and strips non-interactive container tags.

playwright.observation_method: W3C Accessibility Tree snapshot / YAML aria_snapshot locator abstraction
playwright.test_method: Source code and API specification inspection (playwright.dev/python/docs/api/class-accessibility)
playwright.source_inspection_note: Verified by source inspection only. Playwright accessibility snapshot serializes native AXTree nodes; data-* and script elements are excluded by specification.
playwright.limitations: Package playwright is not installed in .venv311. Cannot serialize non-standard DOM attributes.

browsergym.observation_method: Hybrid AXTree extraction ('axtree_txt') or pruned HTML extraction via Playwright harness
browsergym.source_inspection_note: Verified by source inspection only. Default BrowserGym AXTree mode strictly mirrors Blink accessibility tree semantics.
browsergym.limitations: Package browsergym is not installed in .venv311. Requires Playwright backend.
